diagnostics.ambiguity: Full Jacobian rank is local only and does not prove global uniqueness. In joint mode, d>0 fixes x direction, beacon 2 y>0 selects the planar reflection, and h>0 selects beacons above the fixed tag plane. These conventions select branches rather than supply new measurements.
diagnostics.solution_grouping: Raw canonical geometry RMS over trajectory and beacon xyz, all finite starts

truth_jacobian.interpretation: Local measurement rank only; full rank does not prove global uniqueness
truth_jacobian.scaling: J of normalized range residuals with respect to theta / parameter_scale_m; all parameters in metres

experiment.coordinate_convention: Right-handed Cartesian frame in metres. The planar tag trajectory is z=0. For the informative map, beacon b0=(0,0,h), b1=(d,0,h), b2 has positive y, and all four beacons share height h>0. Beacon IDs are zero-based.

path_motion.display_interpolation: lines joining fitted samples are display chords, not the continuous path
path_motion.parameterization: reference path arclength; narrow coverage uses dense polyline
path_motion.size_convention: full width/height; line uses width as length; circle and arc use equal diameters; waypoint coordinates are local offsets
